card.name: Linking words in boxed warning phrases
card.fires_on: Small words like "for" after REMS, "of" after "weeks" before gestation, and "ing" in "dispensing" in boxed warning text about opioid and NSAID risks.

modes.label: REMS for
modes.description: The word "for" right after the REMS program name in opioid warnings.
modes.example: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)<< for>> these products.

modes.label: Weeks of gestation
modes.description: The word "of" after a span of weeks in NSAID pregnancy warnings.
modes.example: limit dose and duration of Etodolac Tablets use between about 20 and 30 weeks<< of>> gestation

modes.label: Prescribing or dispensing
modes.description: The ending of "dispensing" in the sentence about weighing risks when prescribing opioid products.
modes.example: Consider these risks when prescribing or dispens<<ing>> Hydrocodone Polistirex and

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words inside standard boxed warning sentences for opioids and NSAIDs.
evidence: the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has required a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)<< for>> these products.
limit dose and duration of diclofenac sodium delayed-release tablets use between about 20 and 30 weeks<< of>> gestation
Consider these risks when prescribing or dispens<<ing>> Promethazine HCl and Codeine
